decision: Observe complete readiness using the existing strict clear predicate, within the original 1.8 second settling deadline and at most eight bounded captures. Send only the original one Ctrl+A/Backspace; retain every observation and its deadline outcome. Do not retry the behavioral case.

consequences.qualification: One complete individual capture must meet the unchanged predicate. Never combine properties across captures. Check the deadline after capture and reject late qualification.
consequences.hard_failures: Foreground/seat guard failure, observed false raw or root focus, changed endpoint, missing root, incomplete or unstable tree, and read issues terminate observation rather than being retried until a good sample appears. Save a received tree before post-capture guard/layout checks; record a postcheck error and rethrow without retry.

consequences.evidence: Preserve the original failed row and first unqualified capture. Source controls or a prerequisite PASS cannot regrade behavioral cases or complete matrices.
